headline:
Buy-rated,
but real questions linger
chart_note: 52-week range: $255.97 - $461.62. Currently around $401, about 70% up that range but still working through a rough stretch.
why_today: Trading around $401, about 70% up its 52-week range - a defensive, Buy-rated name still working through operational issues management itself has flagged.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Buy (27 analysts) with an average price target of $475 - about 15% above the current price, and management reaffirmed a 13-16% long-term earnings growth target
pro_2: Beta of just 0.38 makes this one of the more defensive names in the sector, plus a 2.3% dividend yield
con_1: Management itself has publicly acknowledged underperformance issues this year - a real operational red flag, not just market noise
con_2: Still about 13% below its 52-week high ($461.62) after a rough stretch - the stock hasn't fully recovered investor confidence yet
